limitations.quote: The previous 0 and current 1 start an overlapping match
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed two transitions out of the match state to retain the final zero, enabling overlapping detections where the original FSM would return to idle.
The exhaustive test used a rolling valid-bit window as its oracle, so it treated the unintended overlapping detections as correct instead of checking the original post-match behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the test setup to be resubmitted, after an earlier failed Git status check had already forced the source inspection to be rerun.
